codeReview.summary: The worker rewrote tests/unit/test_cli.py from scratch, replacing 4 fully-skipped test classes with 19 passing tests that exercise the current argparse-based CLI surface. All @pytest.mark.skip decorators are removed. TestCLIParser validates parser construction and flag parsing for analyze, serve, and decompile commands. TestCLIHandlers tests handle_analyze_command success/failure/missing-binary paths, create_enhanced_features flag mapping, JSON config loading, and the serve-command import-error path. TestCLIMain verifies main() routing to handlers and error handling for no-command/unknown-command cases. TestCLIIntegration uses subprocess.run against the real CLI script for --help, --version, analyze with missing binary, and analyze --help. Additionally, tests/integration/test_documentation.py had all 12 read_text() calls updated with encoding='utf-8', and a new tests/unit/test_documentation.py regression file was added with 2 UTF-8 read tests. The implementation is clean, well-structured, and correctly aligned with the current CLI module at src/reveng/cli.py.

issues.description: test_handle_analyze_command_success uses a parenthesized context manager with `with (patch.object(...), patch.object(...)):` syntax which requires Python 3.10+. The project documents Python 3.9+ support in CLAUDE.md and pyproject.toml. However, the runtime is Python 3.14 so this works in practice. If the project ever needs to run tests on Python 3.9, this would break.

TestCLIIntegration tests invoke CLI_SCRIPT via subprocess with a 30-second default timeout but no graceful handling if the timeout is exceeded (subprocess.TimeoutExpired would propagate as a test error rather than a clear failure message). This is acceptable for unit tests but could produce confusing failures in slow CI environments.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker deviated from step 6 of the skill procedure by running flake8 against the three changed test files instead of src/reveng/ paths. The deviation was justified since only test files were modified. The skill procedure says 'Run flake8 src/reveng/<changed_files>' which doesn't account for test-only features. The skill could clarify: 'Run flake8 on the changed files (whether in src/reveng/ or tests/)'.
